using System.Reflection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;

using MovieWeb.Services;
using MovieWeb.Repositories;

AppContext.SetSwitch("Npgsql.EnableLegacyTimestampBehavior", true);
var pgPort = int.Parse(args[0]);
var httpPort = int.Parse(args[1]);
var urlKeys = MovieWeb.Helpers.VSMovSource.ServerUrlKeys(new[] { "lồng tiếng #1", "thuyết minh #1", "vietsub #1", "a b", "a-b" });
if (urlKeys["lồng tiếng #1"] != "long-tieng-1" || urlKeys["thuyết minh #1"] != "thuyet-minh-1"
    || urlKeys["a b"] == urlKeys["a-b"]) throw new Exception("Server URL key validation failed");
var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(new WebApplicationOptions
{
    ContentRootPath = @"D:\Doan\webnc\MovieWeb", EnvironmentName = "Development",
    ApplicationName = typeof(SitemapController).Assembly.FullName
});
builder.WebHost.UseUrls($"http://127.0.0.1:{httpPort}");
builder.Logging.AddFilter(_ => false);
builder.Services.AddDbContext<MovieWebDbContext>(o => o.UseNpgsql($"Host=127.0.0.1;Port={pgPort};Database=postgres;Username=seo_fixture;Timeout=5;Command Timeout=10"));
builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();
builder.Services.AddDataProtection().PersistKeysToFileSystem(new DirectoryInfo(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "fixture-keys"))).SetApplicationName("MoonPhimSeoFixture");
builder.Services.AddAuthentication(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme).AddCookie();
builder.Services.AddAuthorization();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IAnnouncementService>(_ => DispatchProxy.Create<IAnnouncementService, OfflineProxy>());
builder.Services.AddScoped<IAuthService>(_ => DispatchProxy.Create<IAuthService, OfflineProxy>());
builder.Services.AddScoped<IMovieSyncService>(_ => DispatchProxy.Create<IMovieSyncService, OfflineProxy>());
builder.Services.AddScoped<IMovieRepository>(_ => DispatchProxy.Create<IMovieRepository, OfflineProxy>());
builder.Services.AddControllersWithViews().AddApplicationPart(typeof(SitemapController).Assembly);
var app = builder.Build();
using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<MovieWebDbContext>();
    await db.Database.EnsureCreatedAsync();
    if (!await db.Movies.AnyAsync())
    {
        var category = new Category { Name = "Hoạt hình", Slug = "hoat-hinh", IsActive = true };
        var country = new Country { Name = "Hàn Quốc", Slug = "han-quoc", IsActive = true };
        db.Add(new Category { Name = "Rỗng", Slug = "rong", IsActive = true });
        for (var i = 1; i <= 32; i++)
        {
            var movie = new Movie { Slug = $"seo-phim-{i}", Name = $"Phim SEO {i}", OriginalName = $"Original Film {i}",
                Description = "<p>Nội dung &amp; câu chuyện phim thử nghiệm.</p>", Type = i % 3 == 0 ? "hoathinh" : i % 2 == 0 ? "series" : "single",
                Language = "Vietsub", Year = 2024, IsActive = true, Quality = "HD", EpisodeCurrent = "Tập 1", EpisodeTotal = "16",
                CreatedAt = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1), UpdatedAt = new DateTime(2024, 2, 1),
                TrailerUrl = "https://a.streamvsmov.com/video/9f3a0de0-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
                PosterUrl = "https://vsmov.com/storage/images/test.jpg", Categories = [category], Countries = [country] };
            movie.Episodes.Add(new Episode { EpisodeName = "1", Slug = "tap-1", ServerName = "Vietsub", LinkM3u8 = movie.TrailerUrl });
            db.Movies.Add(movie);
        }
        db.Movies.Add(new Movie { Slug = "seo-trailer", Name = "Trailer only", IsActive = true, Trailer = "https://youtu.be/abc", Year = 2024 });
        db.Movies.Add(new Movie { Slug = "seo-invalid", Name = "Invalid", IsActive = true, TrailerUrl = "https://evil.example/player" });
        db.Movies.Add(new Movie { Slug = "seo-inactive", Name = "Inactive", IsActive = false });
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}
using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<MovieWebDbContext>();
    OfflineProxy.ProviderResponse = new MovieWeb.Models.API.VSMovDetailResponse
    {
        Status = true,
        Item = new MovieWeb.Models.API.VSMovItem
        {
            Id = 90001, Name = "Sync fixture", Slug = "seo-sync-fixture", OriginName = "Sync Original",
            Content = "Fixture description", Type = "series", Status = "ongoing", Lang = "Vietsub", Year = 2024,
            Category = [new() { Id = "fixture-cat", Name = "Fixture category", Slug = "fixture-category" }],
            Country = [new() { Id = "fixture-country", Name = "Fixture country", Slug = "fixture-country" }],
            Actor = ["Fixture actor"], Director = ["Fixture director"]
        },
        Episodes = [new() { ServerName = "Vietsub", ServerData = [new() { Name = "1", Slug = "tap-1",
            LinkEmbed = "https://a.streamvsmov.com/video/9f3a0de0-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" }] }]
    };
    var sync = new MovieSyncService(db, DispatchProxy.Create<IVSMovService, OfflineProxy>(), NullLogger<MovieSyncService>.Instance,
        new CategorySyncService(db, NullLogger<CategorySyncService>.Instance),
        new CountrySyncService(db, NullLogger<CountrySyncService>.Instance),
        new ActorSyncService(db, NullLogger<ActorSyncService>.Instance),
        new DirectorSyncService(db, NullLogger<DirectorSyncService>.Instance));
    var first = await sync.SyncSingleMovieFromVSMovBySlugWithStatusAsync("seo-sync-fixture");
    if (first.Movie is null) throw new Exception("Fixture sync failed");
    var savedId = first.Movie.Episodes.Single().EpisodeId;
    var oldDate = new DateTime(2000, 1, 1);
    first.Movie.UpdatedAt = oldDate;
    await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    var second = await sync.SyncSingleMovieFromVSMovBySlugWithStatusAsync("seo-sync-fixture");
    if (second.WasUpdatedOrAdded || second.Movie!.UpdatedAt != oldDate) throw new Exception("No-op sync changed lastmod");
    OfflineProxy.ProviderResponse.Item.Content = "Changed description";
    OfflineProxy.ProviderResponse.Item.Category.Add(new() { Id = "fixture-cat-2", Name = "Fixture category 2", Slug = "fixture-category-2" });
    var third = await sync.SyncSingleMovieFromVSMovBySlugWithStatusAsync("seo-sync-fixture");
    if (!third.WasUpdatedOrAdded || third.Movie!.UpdatedAt <= oldDate) throw new Exception("Changed content did not update lastmod");
    if (third.Movie.Episodes.Single().EpisodeId != savedId) throw new Exception("Episode ID changed");
    Console.WriteLine("PASS: VSMov no-op/content-change lastmod and stable EpisodeId");
}
// Exercise the real sync service against a separately held PostgreSQL lock.
{
    MovieSyncService MakeSync(MovieWebDbContext db, IDirectorSyncService? director = null) => new(db,
        DispatchProxy.Create<IVSMovService, OfflineProxy>(), NullLogger<MovieSyncService>.Instance,
        new CategorySyncService(db, NullLogger<CategorySyncService>.Instance),
        new CountrySyncService(db, NullLogger<CountrySyncService>.Instance),
        new ActorSyncService(db, NullLogger<ActorSyncService>.Instance),
        director ?? new DirectorSyncService(db, NullLogger<DirectorSyncService>.Instance));
    using var writerScope = app.Services.CreateScope();
    using var syncScope = app.Services.CreateScope();
    var writer = writerScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<MovieWebDbContext>();
    var syncDb = syncScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<MovieWebDbContext>();
    var stale = await syncDb.Movies.Include(m => m.Episodes).SingleAsync(m => m.Slug == "seo-sync-fixture");
    if (stale.Episodes.Count != 1) throw new Exception("Unexpected concurrency fixture");
    OfflineProxy.ProviderResponse!.Episodes![0].ServerData!.Add(new() { Name = "2", Slug = "tap-2",
        LinkEmbed = "https://a.streamvsmov.com/video/9f3a0de0-0000-4000-8000-000000000002" });
    int addedId;
    Task<(Movie? Movie, bool WasUpdatedOrAdded)> syncing;
    await using (var tx = await MovieWeb.Helpers.CatalogWriteLock.AcquireAsync(writer))
    {
        syncing = MakeSync(syncDb).SyncSingleMovieFromVSMovBySlugWithStatusAsync("seo-sync-fixture");
        await Task.Delay(100);
        if (syncing.IsCompleted) throw new Exception("Sync bypassed shared advisory lock");
        var episode = new Episode { MovieId = stale.MovieId, EpisodeName = "2", Slug = "tap-2", ServerName = "vietsub",
            LinkM3u8 = "https://a.streamvsmov.com/video/9f3a0de0-0000-4000-8000-000000000002" };
        writer.Episodes.Add(episode);
        await writer.SaveChangesAsync();
        addedId = episode.EpisodeId;
        await tx.CommitAsync();
    }
    var result = await syncing;
    if (result.Movie!.Episodes.Count != 2 || result.Movie.Episodes.Single(e => e.Slug == "tap-2").EpisodeId != addedId)
        throw new Exception("Stale tracked graph caused duplicate episode");
    using var blockedScope = app.Services.CreateScope();
    var blockedDb = blockedScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<MovieWebDbContext>();
    await using (var tx = await MovieWeb.Helpers.CatalogWriteLock.AcquireAsync(writer))
    {
        var blocked = await MakeSync(blockedDb).SyncSingleMovieFromVSMovBySlugWithStatusAsync("seo-sync-fixture");
        if (blocked.Movie is not null) throw new Exception("Busy catalog sync did not defer");
        await tx.RollbackAsync();
    }
    OfflineProxy.ProviderResponse.Item!.Slug = "seo-sync-rollback";
    OfflineProxy.ProviderResponse.Item.Id = 90003;
    using var failScope = app.Services.CreateScope();
    var failDb = failScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<MovieWebDbContext>();
    try
    {
        await MakeSync(failDb, new ThrowingDirector()).SyncSingleMovieFromVSMovBySlugWithStatusAsync("seo-sync-rollback");
        throw new Exception("Failure injection unexpectedly succeeded");
    }
    catch (InvalidOperationException ex) when (ex.Message == "injected-director-failure") { }
    if (await failDb.Movies.AnyAsync(m => m.Slug == "seo-sync-rollback") || failDb.ChangeTracker.HasChanges())
        throw new Exception("Failed sync left partial database/context writes");
    Console.WriteLine("PASS: real sync advisory lock, stale EF graph, busy deferral and rollback");
}

if (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SEO_TEST_PERF") == "1")
{
    using var scope = app.Services.CreateScope();
    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<MovieWebDbContext>();
    await db.Database.ExecuteSqlRawAsync("""
        INSERT INTO "Movies" ("Slug", "Name", "Type", "IsActive", "Year", "ViewCount", "CreatedAt", "UpdatedAt", "TrailerUrl", "PosterUrl", "Description")
        SELECT 'perf-fixture-' || g, 'Perf fixture ' || g,
            CASE WHEN g % 2 = 0 THEN 'series' ELSE 'single' END, true, 2000 + g % 26, g * 3,
            timestamp '2024-01-01', timestamp '2024-02-01',
            'https://a.streamvsmov.com/video/9f3a0de0-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
            'https://vsmov.com/storage/images/test.jpg', repeat('Fixture description. ', 100)
        FROM generate_series(1, 4400) g;
        INSERT INTO "Episodes" ("MovieId", "EpisodeName", "Slug", "ServerName", "LinkM3u8")
        SELECT m."MovieId", g::text, 'tap-' || g, 'Vietsub', m."TrailerUrl"
        FROM "Movies" m CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 10) g WHERE m."Slug" LIKE 'perf-fixture-%';
        ANALYZE "Movies";
        ANALYZE "Episodes";
        """);
    Console.WriteLine("PERF_FIXTURE_READY 4400 extra movies and 44000 episodes");
}
app.UseStaticFiles();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllerRoute("catalog", "trang-chu", new { controller = "TrangChu", action = "TrangChu" });
app.MapControllerRoute("default", "{controller=Home}/{action=Index}/{id?}");
Console.WriteLine($"SEO_TEST_READY http://127.0.0.1:{httpPort}");
await app.RunAsync();

public class OfflineProxy : DispatchProxy
{
    public static MovieWeb.Models.API.VSMovDetailResponse? ProviderResponse;
    protected override object? Invoke(MethodInfo? method, object?[]? args)
    {
        if (method?.Name == "GetMovieDetailAsync") return Task.FromResult(ProviderResponse);
        if (method?.Name == "GetSettingsAsync") return Task.FromResult(new MovieWeb.Models.DTOs.AnnouncementSettingsDto { IsEnabled = false });
        if (method?.Name == "GetCurrentUserAsync") return Task.FromResult<User?>(null);
        if (method?.Name == "EnsureVSMovEpisodesAsync") return Task.CompletedTask;
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Unexpected external dependency: " + method?.Name);
    }
}

public sealed class ThrowingDirector : IDirectorSyncService
{
    public Task<List<Director>> SyncDirectorsAsync(List<string> values) => throw new InvalidOperationException("injected-director-failure");
}
